import Mathlib.Data.Fin.SuccPred

opaque A : Type
opaque A.v : A → Nat

def List.v : List A → Nat
| []        => 1
| x :: xs   => x.v + xs.v + 1

lemma lem (l : List A) (m : Fin (l.length)) : l[m].v < l.v := by
  induction l
  · grind
  rename_i head N ih
  simp [List.v]
  by_cases h' : m = 0
  · simp [h']
    grind
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero h'
  simp
  grind [ih y]

lemma lem2 (l : List A) (m n : Fin (l.length)) (h : m < n) : l[m.val].v + l[n.val].v < l.v := by
  induction l
  · grind
  rename_i head N ih
  simp [List.v]
  by_cases h' : m = 0
  · simp [h']
    have : n ≠ 0 := by grind
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero this
    simp
    by_cases h'' : y.1 = 0
    · simp [h'']
      have := lem N ⟨0, by grind⟩
      grind
    · have := ih ⟨0, by grind⟩ y (by refine Fin.mk_lt_of_lt_val ?_; grind)
      grind
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero h'
    simp
    have : n ≠ 0 := by grind
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq_of_ne_zero this
    simp
    have := ih y z
    grind

#print axioms lem2

It was much easier to prove the stronger summation version (though obviously pulling in more of Mathlib here)

import Mathlib

opaque A : Type
opaque A.v : A → Nat

def List.v : List A → Nat
| []        => 1
| x :: xs   => x.v + xs.v + 1

lemma lem2 (l : List A) : ∑ i : Fin l.length, l[i].v < l.v := by
  induction l
  · simp [List.v]
  rename_i head N ih
  simp [List.v]
  rw [@Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp at ⊢ ih
  grind

#print axioms lem2

opaque A : Type
opaque A.v : A → Nat

def List.v : List A → Nat
| []        => 1
| x :: xs   => x.v + xs.v + 1

theorem lemma1 (l : List A) (m : {x // x < l.length}) : l[m.val].v < l.v := by
  induction l
  . grind only [usr Subtype.property, = List.length_nil]
  . rename_i y ys ih
    dsimp [List.v]
    induction m
    rename_i mv mp
    induction mv
    . grind only [= List.getElem_cons]
    . rename_i n ih2
      dsimp at *
      have := ih ⟨n, (by grind only [= List.length_cons])⟩
      lia

theorem lemma2 (l : List A) (m n : {x // x < l.length}) (h : m < n) : l[m.val].v + l[n.val].v < l.v := by
    induction l
    . grind only [usr Subtype.property, = List.length_nil]
    rename_i y ys ih
    dsimp [List.v]
    by_cases h' : m.val = 0
    . simp [h']
      have : n.val != 0 := by grind only
      induction n
      rename_i nv np
      induction nv; contradiction
      rename_i n ih2
      dsimp at *
      have np' : n < ys.length := by grind only [= List.length_cons]
      suffices ys[n].v < ys.v by lia
      exact lemma1 ys ⟨n, np'⟩
    . induction m
      rename_i mv mp
      induction mv; contradiction
      rename_i m ih2
      dsimp at *
      induction n
      rename_i nv np
      induction nv; contradiction
      rename_i n ih3
      dsimp at *
      have := ih ⟨m, by grind only [= List.length_cons]⟩
        ⟨n, by grind only [= List.length_cons]⟩ (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h)
      lia

example (l : List A) (m n : {x // x < l.length}) (h : m != n) : l[m.val].v + l[n.val].v < l.v := by
  by_cases h2 : m < n
  . exact lemma2 l m n h2
  . have _ := lemma2 l n m (by grind)
    lia

Here's a relatively short mathlib-free proof:

opaque A : Type
opaque A.v : A → Nat

def List.v : List A → Nat
| []        => 1
| x :: xs   => x.v + xs.v + 1

theorem v_eq (l : List A) : l.v = (l.map A.v).sum + l.length + 1 := by
  induction l <;> grind [List.v]

theorem List.Sublist.sum_mono {l₁ l₂ : List Nat} (h : l₁.Sublist l₂): l₁.sum ≤ l₂.sum := by
  induction h <;> grind

theorem add_v_lt_of_lt (l : List A) (m n : {x // x < l.length}) (h : m.val < n.val) :
    l[m.val].v + l[n.val].v < l.v := by
  suffices [l[m.val], l[n.val]].Sublist l by grind [v_eq, this.map A.v |>.sum_mono]
  rw [List.cons_sublist_iff]
  refine ⟨_, _, (l.take_append_drop <| m + 1).symm, by grind [List.mem_take_iff_getElem], ?_⟩
  rw [List.singleton_sublist, List.mem_drop_iff_getElem]
  exact ⟨n - m - 1, by grind⟩

theorem add_v_lt_of_ne (l : List A) (m n : {x // x < l.length}) (h : m != n) :
    l[m.val].v + l[n.val].v < l.v := by
  by_cases hlt : m < n
  · exact add_v_lt_of_lt l m n hlt
  · grind [add_v_lt_of_lt l n m <| show n < m by grind]
